name: Touch of Torment
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a touch, you cause the subject to suffer sharp pains that impose a –1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and ability checks.
